summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Kingsoft Cloud Holdings Ltd to the SEC for July 2026. It contains a monthly return submitted to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange detailing movements in authorized and issued share capital for June 2026. The report shows no changes in authorized shares (40 billion ordinary shares, par value USD 0.001) or issued shares (4.53 billion, no treasury shares). It confirms compliance with public float requirements under Main Board Rules. There is no transaction, corporate action, or special situation; it is a routine regulatory filing.
